	<ResortReportHeadline>Another 2cm fresh and the Pirate Life Rail Jam Tonight!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>I was surprised to see it snowing lightly walking across the carpark early this morning. While not a lot, it's added up to a fresh 2 centimetres and mixed in with some overnight snowmaking there should be some fun to be had out there today.</p><p>The current temp is -1.9, headed for a top of 2 degrees and right now there's a moderate WNW wind with stronger gusts at times. There's still the odd fine flake in the air and a light fog in the Village.</p><p>The texture on the groomers feels great underfoot and I reckon they'll be the best option first up on a very edgeable surface. With the cool temps off piste will likely be firm and probably best avoided until some softening occurs.</p><p>For the early birds the Road Runner Quad will be spinning from 7:30am for WRX First Tracks. In more good news the Pirate Life Rail Jam is on tonight down at the Big D. Kicking off at 5:30pm, get along and check out all the action under lights!</p><p>Rug up for the windchill and have a great day. Cheers, Burner.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p></ResortReport>
